set.body:
Goal: one small internal traverse/traverseWithIndex helper to replace the repeated builder + while + var result: Either short-circuit pattern, without importing cats.

Evidence: the pattern (var result: Either ...; while idx < n && result.isRight do ...) appears 21 times: CompilerPhases.scala x10 (22,60,225,239,253,474,534,557,587,634), Device.scala x6 (282,361,370,384,554,629), plus Grammar.scala:249, PlotCompiler.scala:202, Axis.scala:184, Layout.scala:219, PlotLayout.scala:153.

Acceptance: a shared inline helper (allocation-conscious, preserves first-error short-circuit and ordering) replaces the call sites; a couple hundred lines deleted; no behavior change; JVM+JS tests green.
set.title: Graphics: private traverse helper to collapse the while-loop Either accumulation
